## Lecture outline (draft)

Legendre polynomials and spherical harmonics, the addition theorem, Gauss–Legendre quadrature in $\cos\theta$, expansion of a map on a sphere and the power spectrum $C_\ell$. Gauss nodes as an eigenvalue problem (lecture 3).

- **Problem:** The potential of a dipole and a multipole (the reference), the gravitational field of the Earth, the temperature map of the microwave background as a striking example of a field on a sphere.
- **Tools:** $Y_{\ell m}$, Gauss–Legendre quadrature, stability of recurrence relations, analysis and synthesis of a map.
